description: Get the current user's Spotify profile.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the current user's profile object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List playlists owned by the current user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds an items list of playlist objects and a total count; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single playlist including its tracks.

playlist_id.description: The id of the playlist to fetch.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the playlist object with tracks; on failure (playlist not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the tracks of a playlist.

playlist_id.description: The id of the playlist whose tracks are fetched.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a total count and items list of track entries; on failure (playlist not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new playlist owned by a user.

user_id.description: The id of the user who will own the playlist.

public.description: Whether the playlist is public (default true).

collaborative.description: Whether the playlist is collaborative (default false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created playlist object with tracks; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Add one or more tracks (by uri) to a playlist.

playlist_id.description: The id of the playlist to add tracks to.

uris.description: List of track uris (or track ids) to add.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the playlist_id, number added, and a snapshot_id; on failure (playlist not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search tracks, albums and/or artists by name substring.

q.description: The case-insensitive query string to match against names.

type.description: Optional comma-separated types to search (track, album, artist); defaults to all three.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds tracks/albums/artists result buckets each with items and total; on failure, output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the playback state object (is_playing, device, item, etc.); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Start playback of specific track uris or a playlist context.

uris.description: Optional list of track uris to play; the first is used as the current item.

context_uri.description: Optional playlist context uri (spotify:playlist:...) to play from.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated playback state object; on failure, output contains an error message.
